text_to_speech: hi my name is Jessica kogan and I'm running for 2L Senator I think I'm qualified for this position because in my undergraduate career I was president of one of the largest student organizations on campus there I learned how to be an accessible and effective leader and those are the qualities I think I can bring to the table by being an effective leader I think that the ideas that I'm bringing to you are ones that I can personally pursue and make sure happen on this campus my first idea is in the library during final study time to have a quiet dark room so that you can go and Escape for 5 10 30 minutes take a quick nap whatever it is to escape the chaos of the library during finals exam time my second idea is to implement a campus-wide mentoring program I know smaller student organizations do this but I think it would be very easy to implement in our campus to have the one L's meet with 2 L's to gain advice and get a support system on campus for their first year and the two Ls get advice from 3 L's so that they can learn how to effectively Market themselves and gain into internship and job opportunities these are just a few of the ideas that I have please come up to me this week introduce yourself and share with me the ideas that you have so we can work on them together and Implement them on this campus thank you vote for Jessica

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, my name is Jessica Coggan and I'm running for 2L Senator. I think I'm
qualified for this position because in my undergraduate career I was
president of one of the largest student organizations on campus. There I learned
how to be an accessible and effective leader and those are the qualities I
think I can bring to the table. By being an effective leader I think that the
ideas that I bring to you are ones that I can personally pursue and make sure
happen on this campus. My first idea is in the library during the final study
time to have a quiet dark room so that you can go and escape for five, ten,
thirty minutes, take a quick nap, whatever it is to escape the chaos of the
library during finals exam time. My second idea is to implement a campus-wide
mentoring program. I know smaller student organizations do this but I think it
would be very easy to implement an R campus. To have the one-house meet with
2Ls to gain advice and get a support system on campus for their first year
and the 2Ls get advice from 3Ls so that they can learn how to effectively
market themselves and gain internship and job opportunities. These are just a
few of the ideas that I have. Please come up to me this week, introduce yourself,
and share with me the ideas that you have so we can work on them together and
implement them on this campus. Thank you. Vote for Jessica.
